blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jude Garcia wasted no time picking up where he left off after the Asian Games, spearheading Criss Cross’ 25-15, 25-14, 25-12 demolition of the Armed Forces of the Philippines in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The five-time Conference Most Valuable Player erupted for 13 points on seven kills, four blocks and two aces as the King Crunchers opened their bid for a third consecutive championship with a straight-sets victory in just 78 minutes. “We’re still adjusting because we’ve only been playing together for a few weeks.
